sam: Quick sync — ran a short Hopper vs Ampere sweep across a few 7B open models (llama2-7b, mistral-7b, falcon-7b). Prefill+decode numbers below. TL;DR: Hopper ~40% faster on decode and ~20% on prefill; cost gap depends on region pricing and quant profile.

jess: where are the raw numbers? which regions / instance SKUs?

sam: pasted raw CSV from the run (fresh run, batch=1 decode, continuous prefill, KV cache enabled for chat traces):
```
model,gpu,region,prefill_ms,decode_ms,tokens_sec,$/1M_tokens,notes
llama2-7b,hopper,us-west-2,210,95,4800,1.85,4-bit QAT
llama2-7b,ampere,us-west-2,260,140,3200,2.75,4-bit QAT
mistral-7b,hopper,us-east-1,230,110,4400,2.00,8-bit
mistral-7b,ampere,us-east-1,290,160,3000,2.90,8-bit
falcon-7b,hopper,us-west-2,240,120,4200,2.10,kv-cache tuned
falcon-7b,ampere,us-west-2,300,170,2800,3.10,kv-cache tuned
```
kai: solid. did you capture kernel-level telemetry? i'm trying to see where the delta comes from (prefill vs decode).

sam: yes — quick notes: prefill on Hopper hit the newer fused attention path (flash_attn_v2 / optimized cuDNN kernels) so lower memory traffic => ~20% prefill win. Decode uses smaller GEMMs + KV cache ops; Hopper benefits from sparse/AMP-friendly cutlass kernels and better TF32 throughput, hence ~35-45% decode win. Ampere run used fallback kernels that are slightly less optimized for our 4-bit codegen.

maria: for capacity planning — rough calc: if you need 1,000,000 tokens/sec sustained: using the llama2-7b numbers (tokens_sec per GPU) that's ~1e6 / 4800 ≈ 209 H100 GPUs, or ~1e6 / 3200 ≈ 313 A100 GPUs (region/price dependent). that's raw GPU count before headroom. :thinking_face:

jess: any quality regressions from the Q4 quant profiles? we care about eval pass rate for chat safety prompts.

sam: ran a 1k prompt eval set across models: 4-bit QAT on llama2-7b showed ~0.2% drop in top-token match and negligible change in safety filter triggers. mistral 8-bit had basically zero quality delta. we'll upload eval diffs.

kai: also note throughput numbers were measured with continuous batching disabled; with small batching (batch=4) tokens/sec on decode improved ~8-12% on both GPUs but increased p95 latency slightly. tradeoff obvious.

deploy-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-ml/bench/1977654321/ (raw logs, perf traces, kernel selection CSV) :white_check_mark:

maria: perfect — can you add region cost assumptions (instance hourly and GPU price) to the bucket? want to convert $/1M_tokens to our pricing model for Dedicated estimates.

sam: will do, and i'll run a cheaper-region sweep (eu, apac) next round. adding notes to the s3 folder. :rocket:
